text:
morgan: 🚨 Alerts from eu-west-1 — gpu-nodepool-1 at 100% alloc, ~42 pods Pending, CA thrashing. Seeing OOM evictions in training-ns.

infra-bot: [ALERT] Cluster eu-west-1: GPU utilization 99%, Pending pods 42, ENI usage 98/100. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/abc123

raj: I'm on it. Please hold any new training pushes to eu-west-1. @samantha @kevin please ack.

samantha: ack — canceling the scheduled vision-batch-aug run. Rolling back latest canary in vision-service as well.

kevin: Autoscaler logs show rapid scale events: "ScaleUp: +20 nodes" -> "ScaleDown: -8" -> "ScaleUp: +18" within 6m. Looks like many small jobs coming in concurrently, causing a thundering scale pattern.

carlos: Also hitting ENI quota: provider shows ENI usage 98/100 in region. New nodes are failing to provision due to ENI exhaustion.

morgan: Mitigation plan: 1) taint spot-pool nodes to stop new GPU pods there, 2) pause/mark low-priority batch jobs, 3) temporarily increase CA scaleDownDelay to reduce flapping, 4) request ENI quota bump with cloud provider, 5) spin up fallback nodepool in another region if quota not available.

dina: Taunting spot-pool now: `kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=spot-pool gpu-burst=blocked:NoSchedule` — applying to 6 nodes. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Taint applied to 6 nodes labeled nodepool=spot-pool. Cluster autoscaler config patched: scaleDownDelaySeconds=300 (temp).

raj: Pushed an emergency admission rule to rate-limit job creation in eu-west-1 for 10m to prevent new small jobs from triggering scale cycles.

samantha: Workload owners: please patch running jobs to priorityClass=low or pause them. Example patch: ```kubectl patch job vision-batch-aug -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"priorityClassName": "low-priority"}}}}'```

kevin: Opened cloud support ticket INC-8392 requesting ENI quota increase (requested +50). ETA quoted 25-40m. Meanwhile spinning up a fallback nodepool eu-central-standby with larger instances and pre-warmed images (to reduce boot time).

carlos: Temporarily bumped maxNodes for eu-west1-autoscaler to 200 to allow reasonable scale-up if ENIs free up, and capped surge to +3 nodes to limit churn.

morgan: After taint + pausing batches, Pending dropped from ~42 -> 6 over 4m. GPU utilization trending down. Leaving rate-limit in place for another 10m. Monitoring for ENI quota update.

infra-bot: Incident severity set to P1. Created postmortem stub: https://redwood.incidents/1969000000 — please add notes.

morgan: Good recovery now but RCA required on why scheduled jobs alignment + CA settings created this oscillation. We'll do timeline and follow-ups in postmortem. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
